summary_1line: Yudhishthira laments the mass slaughter of kin in the war, while Vyasa argues destiny, duty, and Time—not Yudhishthira alone—caused the deaths.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira stands grief-stricken before the sage Vyasa, lamenting the countless fallen kings and kinsmen after the devastating war.
Widowed queens with emaciated faces collapse upon the earth in grief for husbands and sons slain in battle.
Vyasa speaks solemnly to Yudhishthira, describing Time as an unseen force that slays warriors through the hands of other men.
